safety_edits.revised: Chill: Refrigerate the custard pie promptly after a brief initial cooling period; do not leave it on the counter for four hours. Keep total time at room temperature under 2 hours (under 1 hour above 32°C / 90°F), then chill until the filling is set.

safety_edits.original: Pull the marinated chicken container from the refrigerator well ahead of cooking. Allow the meat to sit on the counter until it safely climbs up close to room temperature before it touches any hot grease. Frying room-temperature chicken prevents the oil from dropping in temperature too rapidly and cuts down on dangerous oil popping.
safety_edits.revised: Keep the marinated chicken refrigerated until you are ready to coat and cook it. Drain off excess marinade before coating. Do not leave raw chicken out to warm to room temperature.

safety_edits.original: Confirm that the internal temperature reads securely between 65°C and 74°C (150°F to 165°F) . Note: Taking the chicken out within this sweet spot keeps the interior meat bursting with juices without drying out.
safety_edits.revised: Confirm that every piece reaches an internal temperature of at least 74°C (165°F) in the thickest part, without touching bone. Use a food thermometer; color and floating are not reliable safety checks.
